Edge-to-edge enforcement in Android 16

Android 16 enforces edge-to-edge display for all apps targeting SDK 36. The minimum supported compile SDK version is 36.

Apps must handle window insets explicitly. The system bars are transparent by default, and content draws behind them unless your layout consumes the insets.

Migration steps

First, remove any fitsSystemWindows flags that conflict with the new defaults. Then test on a large-screen device.
